blocks.html: Where the embedded length of deep foundations located near a lot line would be reduced to less than 10 feet (3048 mm) by excavation of the adjacent site to a depth of 10 feet (3048 mm) below the nearest established curb level, the provisions of Section 1810.7.4 shall apply.
